entries.d737468966f82246: Its medium- to long-term vision is 'Supporting global safety and security through the pursuit of Total Cable Technology'. Under the medium-term management plan 'TCTRX' covering the fiscal years ended March 2025 through March 2027, it aims to maintain its business foundation and strengthen profitability, with three basic policies: strengthening the allocation of management resources to priority growth businesses, strengthening the competitiveness of existing businesses, and building a company attractive to all stakeholders. Ahead of its 140th anniversary in April 2027, the company states that by pursuing Total Cable Technology it aims to become a 150-year company that supports global safety and security.
